analysis.scope: Empirical matched interventions on a balanced synthetic challenge set. Memory changes information; Sonnet corrective review adds compute. No assumed model independence or production incidence rate.
analysis.uncertainty: 16 arm/stream intervals share a separate 5% error budget; 12 paired-difference intervals share another 5%. Conditional averages over completed episodes, not future forecasts. Unresolved responses are task failures and excluded from financial estimates.
analysis.direction: Negative proposed-loss change favors the second configuration. Corrected/introduced task errors must be considered together.
